page.overview:
Who is Tsui Park?

Tsui Park is a character in the 1995 novel Mortal Kombat. Tsui is possessed by his father, Yong Park, and gain the fighting skill he needs for revenge, becoming Scorpion.

Tsui Park is an artist and the teenaged son of Yong Park, a former Lin Kuei assassin who left to become a toll-taker. The Park family lived by the canal.

One day, Tsui and his mother were dragged to the booth where his father worked by Sub-Zero, who forced them to watch how he slaughtered Yong by disemboweling him and tossed his body into the canal. Tsui and his mother could do nothing but crying and screaming out of dispair.

Afterwards, Tsui tried to retrieve his father's body alone as no one had been brave enough to help since the rumor had it that Yong was murdered by a certain group and people were fear of being killed for helping the family.
